basic_details.job_title: IIIT Bhopal Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Information Technology, Bhopal will hold a walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 from 01:00 PM onwards at the Conference Room, New Teaching Block, IIIT Bhopal; the notice prints no PIN code for the venue. content_sections.heading: IIIT Bhopal Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Conference Room, New Teaching Block, IIIT Bhopal
Eligible candidates with the qualification below, preferably below 30 years as on the date of interview

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is to be engaged on the project "Advanced Optical Anti-Counterfeiting and Data Storage using Lanthanide-Activated Composites". The project duration is 2 years. Preference: GATE/NET qualified candidates. Desirables: knowledge of Material Synthesis, Material Characterization, Fabrication of Thin Film Devices, Electronic Device measurements, Results Analysis, Simulation Tools, and technical writing skills. Preferably below 30 years as on the date of interview. Relaxation to SC/ST/OBC will be provided as per Institute norms; the notice prints no figure for the relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification: B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech in Electronics/Engg. Physics/Computer Science/Allied specializations, OR Master's degree in Physics/Electronics/Allied Specializations with a minimum of 60% marks at the postgraduate level

content_sections.heading: Terms of the Appointment
content_sections.text: The appointment shall initially be for one year, extendable for an additional period of one year or until completion of the project, whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance and project requirements. The position is purely temporary and on contract basis, and co-terminus at any time with the project without any notification. Continuation will depend on the satisfaction of research performance. Selected candidates are expected to join immediately. Selected candidates will not be permitted to claim any regular or part-time appointment in the Institute.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form (the form is on page 2 of the notice; it has a space to paste a passport size photo). Curriculum vitae, with complete details of educational qualifications, research experience and publications (if any). All relevant original certificates. One set of self-attested photocopies of all relevant supporting documents. Two passport size photographs. The application form asks for name, category (Gen/EWS/OBC/SC/ST), gender, age, correspondence address, email ID and mobile number. It also asks for degree details (10th, 10+2/Intermediate, BE/BTech, ME/MTech, others) with subject, division, percentage and year of completion, plus GATE/NET details, knowledge of simulation tools and publication details, if any.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature (printed in the application form declaration). The application form declaration also records the contract, co-terminus and no-regular-appointment conditions listed above. Queries about the post go to the PI or Co-PI: Dr. Neeraj Kumar Giri, Assistant Professor and PI, [email protected] ; or Dr. Jogendra Singh Rana, Assistant Professor and Co-PI, [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When is the IIIT Bhopal JRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026 from 01:00 PM onwards.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the IIIT Bhopal JRF interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at the Conference Room, New Teaching Block, IIIT Bhopal.

faq.question: Q3. How many JRF vacancies are there at IIIT Bhopal?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) position of Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the IIIT Bhopal JRF post?
faq.answer: B.E/B.Tech/M.E/M.Tech in Electronics/Engg. Physics/Computer Science/Allied specializations, or a Master's degree in Physics/Electronics/Allied Specializations with a minimum of 60% marks at the postgraduate level. GATE/NET qualified candidates are preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the IIIT Bhopal JRF post?
faq.answer: Preferably below 30 years as on the date of interview. SC/ST/OBC candidates get relaxation as per Institute norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the fellowship for the IIIT Bhopal JRF post?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 20,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled-in application form, curriculum vitae, relevant original certificates with a set of self-attested photocopies, and two passport size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIIT Bhopal JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely temporary and on contract basis, initially for one year, extendable for an additional year or until completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can a selected JRF claim a regular post at IIIT Bhopal?
faq.answer: No. Selected candidates will not be permitted to claim any regular or part-time appointment in the Institute.
